about: Nodes of the meteorology lineage graph, type "site": what people look at. Ids are stable (incident.entities@ may adopt them); meaning is in the edges (meteorology/edges/), not here.

nodes.name: IPMA
nodes.summary: Home: the map of warnings by district with a day selector, the forecast for the capitals, the latest communiqués and the seismic map.

nodes.name: Windy
nodes.summary: A full-screen animated map (wind particles over a colour field) with a layer menu (wind, gusts, rain, waves, pressure), a model switch (ECMWF, GFS, ICON, AROME) and a time slider along the bottom.

nodes.name: Ventusky
nodes.summary: Animated map like Windy, with a strong gust layer and fronts drawn on the map.

nodes.name: earth.nullschool.net
nodes.summary: The globe with flowing wind lines (GFS), minimal chrome: the picture is the page.

nodes.name: Zoom Earth
nodes.summary: Near-real-time satellite imagery with a time scrubber; radar, wind and pressure layers.

nodes.name: Yr (MET Norway and NRK)
nodes.summary: A place page with one table: a row per day that opens into a row per hour (symbol, temperature, precipitation in mm, wind speed with an arrow and the wind in words).

nodes.name: meteoblue
nodes.summary: Lisbon read: a 7-day strip with predictability per day as a percentage.

nodes.name: The Weather Channel (weather.com)
nodes.summary: Place card (now, feels like, high/low), hourly and 10-day, radar map, video.

nodes.name: AccuWeather
nodes.summary: Not opened (403). Known for minute-by-minute precipitation and its own impact scales.

nodes.name: BBC Weather
nodes.summary: A place page that is one horizontal strip: day tabs across the top, under them an hour-by-hour row (symbol, temperature, chance of precipitation, wind arrow with speed.

nodes.name: Weather Underground
nodes.summary: A network of personal weather stations on a map (Lisbon has many), each with its own page and history graph.

nodes.name: Foreca
nodes.summary: Clean place pages, hourly table, rain…

nodes.name: Weather & Radar
nodes.summary: Radar-first home page with a play bar from past to…

nodes.name: RainViewer
nodes.summary: Worldwide radar composite as map tiles with past…

nodes.name: Blitzortung / LightningMaps
nodes.summary: Real-time lightning strikes on a map, from volunteers' receivers.

nodes.name: Meteociel
nodes.summary: Every model run as static charts (GFS, ECMWF, AROME, ARPEGE, ICON), observations and soundings.

nodes.name: Wetterzentrale
nodes.summary: Model chart archive and ensembles ("spaghetti"…

nodes.name: Tropical Tidbits
nodes.summary: Model charts with a frame slider and keyboard stepping; storm pages.

nodes.name: Windguru
nodes.summary: A colour-coded table for a spot (Guincho was read and rendered): live readings from nearby stations first, then columns of hours and rows for wind, gust, direction, wave, period, rain.

nodes.name: Windfinder
nodes.summary: Wind map and spot forecasts with live station…

nodes.name: Pirate Weather
nodes.summary: An open forecast API in the old Dark Sky shape (minutely, hourly, alerts).

nodes.name: ECMWF charts and open data
nodes.summary: The reference global model: chart catalogue (mean sea level pressure and wind, ensemble meteograms for any point, extreme forecast index).

nodes.name: EUMETSAT EUMETView
nodes.summary: Satellite imagery viewer (Meteosat: airmass, natural colour, infrared) with animation.

nodes.name: NASA Worldview / GIBS
nodes.summary: Daily global true-colour imagery with a date slider; GIBS serves the tiles.

nodes.name: tempo.pt (Meteored)
nodes.summary: Place forecasts for 14 days with hourly detail, warnings, radar, satellite and model maps.

nodes.name: Luso Meteo
nodes.summary: An independent forecasting site with its own maps and daily analysis.

nodes.name: MeteoPT
nodes.summary: The Portuguese meteorology forum: follow-up threads per region and per event where members post their own station readings, radar captures and model reading, minute by minute.

nodes.name: SAPO Tempo and SAPO front page
nodes.summary: The portal's front page aggregates the storm headlines of many outlets (SIC, Executive Digest, others).

nodes.name: RTP Notícias
nodes.summary: Runs the national live blog on Charles (see the Storm Charles map).

nodes.name: SIC Notícias: meteorologia
nodes.summary: Not opened (403). Its headlines were read through SAPO's front page.

nodes.name: CNN Portugal / TVI: meteorologia
nodes.summary: A weather section that is mostly video: studio explainers and reporters on the ground, each with its length and time.

nodes.name: Público: meteorologia
nodes.summary: A standing weather section; live blog and "what you need to know" piece on Charles.

nodes.name: Observador
nodes.summary: Live blog (general news) and a long special on Charles with embedded gust maps.

nodes.name: Renascença: "Monitorização Depressão Charles"
nodes.summary: The only purpose-built tracker found. A dashboard with two views: weather warnings (a risk map by warning area, a national severity figure, "warnings in my area" by the reader's location, the day's warnings sorted by importance and time) and…

nodes.name: Severe Weather Europe
nodes.summary: Long explainers on large events with many model…

nodes.name: ESTOFEX
nodes.summary: Convective outlooks for Europe: a map with level lines and a reasoned text.

nodes.name: Aviation Weather Center data API
nodes.summary: METAR and TAF for any airport as JSON; Lisbon's TAF answered.

nodes.name: OGIMET
nodes.summary: Decoded SYNOP, METAR and TAF archive for any…

nodes.name: Iowa Environmental Mesonet
nodes.summary: Archive of METAR/TAF worldwide and of every US warning text, with download.
